text: France maintains a 3% digital services tax applicable to large technology companies generating revenue in France. text: The U.K. government announced a planned ban on social media services for users under 16, with implementation targeted for 2027. Existing platform access structures remain active. meta.note: The proposed restrictions are not yet operative, requiring contingency classification alongside active governance claims.
